ADDED i2: Left input: 8 NUL characters; right input: a 14-character string that shares no characters with the left input, so the true Levenshtein distance is 14.
ADDED i3: A threshold of 13 is below the true distance of 14.
ADDED i4: Because the distance (14) is greater than the threshold (13), apply() reports the "not within threshold" sentinel value of -1.
ADDED i5: A LevenshteinDistance cannot be built with a negative threshold, so reusing the -1 sentinel as a threshold is rejected.
